facts.business: Goodyear India Limited manufactures and sells tires for automotive, SUV, and farm segments in India.
key_risks: Reliance on imported crude oil leading to inflationary and cost pressures
Regulatory changes such as New Labour Codes impacting financials
facts.related_party_note: The Goodyear Tire & Rubber Company, Akron, Ohio, USA (Ultimate holding company) issues stock-based awards to the Company's employees under their approved Performance Plan. The Company reimburses the ultimate holding company the cost of share issuance on vesting of RSUs.
